{{Vanilla|Stick}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''stick''' is a basic crafting material. [[Matcha Flavoured]] lets sticks be made directly from logs; leaves no longer drop them.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Two logs make 16 sticks, and two planks make 4 as in vanilla.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sticks_from_logs.json}}</ref> Dead bushes drop 0–2 sticks. [[Leaves]] drop none.

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Data/Uses/Stick}}<!-- called directly: through {{Uses}} the table exceeds the post-expand include limit -->
Sticks are used in [[Kindling|kindling]], [[tinder]], torches, ladders and most tools.
